positions.why: Coup Nigeria with How I Learned to Stop Worrying, not the China Card: do not spend the China Card on a non-Asia coup.
With the right card (How I Learned), coup Nigeria.
Any of the three South America battleground coups is fine; realignment dynamics make the best one unclear.
Europe Scoring is still out, so go Europe (France), unless Laos is needed to stop or take domination. Never Vietnam: Vietnam Revolts is still in the deck.
A good move either way; prefer Zaire so Portuguese Empire Crumbles and South African Unrest are not made "free" (they cover Angola already).

Brazil (or Venezuela) is fine. Separately: the US should play Cultural Revolution as soon as possible while it does not hold the China Card. Open question from the maintainer: what is Africa doing? (The USSR holds Africa Scoring, and one more Battleground gives it domination.)
positions.note: Maintainer wrote "Brazil/argentina fine"; Argentina is USSR-controlled (0-2) and not in the bot's top options, so Venezuela is recorded pending confirmation.
